title: Two bromines join
hook: Predict the product, then compare the bonds.

knows: Structural formula bonds and common organic functional groups.
doesNotKnow: Bromine adds across the carbon–carbon double bond. Each carbon gains a bromine and the double bond becomes a single bond, forming 1,2-dibromoethane.

misconception: Reaction conditions do not affect the connectivity of the product.
objective: Predict the organic product of ethene under the stated conditions and identify the changed connectivity.

claims.text: Question, structural diagrams, product and explanation: Ethene is treated with Br₂ in an inert solvent. Which major organic product forms after workup? Bromine adds across the carbon–carbon double bond. Each carbon gains a bromine and the double bond becomes a single bond, forming 1,2-dibromoethane.
The diagrams use condensed labels and depict connectivity rather than molecular geometry; highlighting identifies selected changed groups.
